messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Added “Deal name” under “Reproduce a game.” Names now save and return when progress is loaded, while older unnamed saves remain supported.

Fixed pasted snapshots being rejected when JSON fields appear in a different order.

Build, 147 unit checks, and 81 browser journeys passed. Changed files pass formatting; 10 untouched files have pre-existing formatting issues.
